messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 — Multiple private connectivity alerts from AcmeCorp (eu-central-2) showing intermittent reachability to their PrivateConnect endpoint. Auto-pager sent to oncall. https://redwood-infra/incident/2183456789
Oncall Bot: Pagerduty: paging alice.m -> Alice M (SRE) :bell:
Alice M: got the page, joining. Any loud customer reports?
Acme SE: We're seeing API calls drop ~30% from our eu customers, some requests timeout and retry, doubles traffic on our peering metric. Impacting checkout flows.
Carmen L: Noted — I'm on with Acme and will update. Customer impact: partial degradations, retries causing cost spike.
Alice M: OK starting triage — net checks first. Ben K, net team can you confirm BGP/route state for Acme's prefix?
Ben K: looking. Pulling neighbor table from core. Running `show ip bgp neighbors 10.12.34.5 advertised-routes`
Ben K: output snippet:
```
BGP neighbor 10.12.34.5:
  Remote AS 65200, remote router-id 10.12.34.5
  Advertised routes: 203.0.113.0/24 (via PE-12), 198.51.100.0/24 (via PE-9)
  Observed multipath: yes, 2 paths for 203.0.113.0/24
```
SRE Night: interesting, multipath observed. Could be asymmetric forwarding + ECMP causing retransmits. Any flaps?
NetBot: Alert: euc-fabric-az-b2 reported route flap counter spike at 2026-03-15T21:13Z.
Ben K: I also see route leaking — our PE9 is advertising the same /24 out of an older virtual router instance that should have been withdrawn after failover. Suspect stale RIB entry from control-plane race.
Alice M: Can you show the active RIB for that prefix?
Ben K: RIB snapshot:
```
RIB> 203.0.113.0/24
  * via 10.1.1.5 (PE-12) weight 100
  * via 10.1.2.7 (PE-9) weight 50 (stale, advertised)
```
Alice M: That explains duplication. Traffic split, some packets go to a path that doesn't have the customer's session state -> timeouts and retries.
Ben K: I'll withdraw the secondary advertisement from PE-9 now. Command: `bgp neighbor 10.1.2.7 soft-reconfig inbound` then `clear ip bgp 10.1.2.7 route 203.0.113.0/24`
Alice M: Do it. I'll monitor customer-facing metrics and traceroutes.
Ben K: done. bgp states cleared, withdraw propagated.
NetBot: Event: withdrawn route observed across fabric at 21:18:02Z.
Alice M: Traceroute from edge->customer now shows consistent hop path to PE-12 only. Latency back to normal in preliminary sampling.
Acme SE: We're seeing successful request rate climb back to ~98% — thanks.
Carmen L: Customer informed. Notifying them we're performing follow-up and postmortem.
SRE Night: Quick note — TTLs on their DNS were low (60s) and retries amplified the visible impact. Add that to RCA.
Alice M: Agree. Immediate mitigations: 1) withdrew stale advertisement (done) 2) added temporary route-map to prefer PE-12 for Acme prefix 3) alerted net ops to run control-plane reconciliation against PE-9.
Ben K: I'm scheduling reconcile job and will check for any similar stale RIBs for other customers. Running `scripts/validate-rib --region euc --check-stale` now.
Oncall Bot: Handing off to Ben K for follow-up (oncall until 02:00Z). :handshake:
Alice M: handing incident to Ben for postmortem. I'll update incident status to "mitigated" and keep monitoring for 1hr.
IncidentBot: Incident status changed: Mitigated -> Monitoring. Severity remains S2 until postmortem complete.
Ben K: Action items captured: (1) control-plane reconcile for PE-9 (2) add acceptance tests to detect duplicate advertisements (3) coordinate with infra to harden VR failover script. I'll own PM.
Carmen L: I'll schedule a short customer follow-up call and send an impact summary.
Alice M: Thanks team. If any reoccurrence, we escalate to SEV1. Otherwise we'll draft postmortem with timelines and contributing factors (BGP race on VR failover + low DNS TTL + retries). :thumbsup:
Acme SE: Appreciate the quick response. We'll hold on the follow-up call until Ben shares the PM notes.
NetBot: Note: fabric firmware patch pending for AZ-B2 scheduled next week; we should correlate once PM is out.
SRE Night: marking logs and traces with tag `incident/2183456789` for eval.
Alice M: closing slack thread for active coordination. Postmortem draft assigned to Ben.
